registration_basis: Recorded after actual read_file/decoded numbered Bash displays of the carried callers, selected complete helpers and bounded XAML tags. The initial mixed caller/root output was truncated and was not used as completeness proof; whole caller redisplays succeeded. Helper groups 0/1 shared scratch was overwritten; actual successful displays, not that scratch, underlie this log. No reconstruction of R6 chronology. Hash/coverage guards only recheck identity and range coverage.

unsupported_read_file_fallbacks.disposition: read_file reported application/octet-stream; decoded numbered Bash displays supplied the complete selected caller/helper bodies and class tail. Not counted as successful read_file, not left as an external-source gap.

range_semantics: Ranges are recorded views and may overlap. XML entries certify selected opening-tag/range identity only, not a fresh whole-XAML review. No sum of context counts is a semantic/capability/independent-read certificate.
